mapper.sql: SELECT definition.id, definition.application_code, definition.application_name, definition.application_type_id, application_type.type_name AS application_type_name, definition.description, definition.icon, definition.approval_config_id, definition.visibility, definition.show_in_resource_application, definition.sort_order, definition.status, definition.created_at, definition.updated_at, definition.deleted_at, config.flow_name AS approval_config_name, config.asset_type AS approval_asset_type, config.enabled AS approval_config_enabled FROM media_application_definition definition JOIN media_application_type application_type ON application_type.id = definition.application_type_id AND application_type.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN media_approval_config config ON config.id = definition.approval_config_id AND config.deleted_at = 0
mapper.select:
WHERE definition.deleted_at = 0
AND definition.status = 1 AND config.enabled = 1 AND (definition.visibility = 'all' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id AND role.deleted_at = 0 AND role.status = 1 WHERE user_role.user_id = #{viewerId} AND user_role.deleted_at = 0 AND UPPER(role.role_code) IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') ))
AND (definition.application_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR definition.application_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND definition.status = #{status} AND definition.approval_config_id = #{approvalConfigId} ORDER BY definition.sort_order, definition.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_application_definition WHERE application_code = #{applicationCode} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE media_application_definition SET application_name = #{applicationName}, application_type_id = #{applicationTypeId}, description = #{description}, icon = #{icon}, visibility = #{visibility}, show_in_resource_application = #{showInResourceApplication}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
